exercises.prompt: Which triliteral form conjugates with the same vowel pattern as a base quadriliteral verb (فَعْلَلَ / يُفَعْلِلُ)?
exercises.explanation: Base quadriliterals (فَعْلَلَ / يُفَعْلِلُ) take ḍammah on the imperfect prefix and kasrah before C4, mirroring Form II triliterals.

feedback.rule: Quadriliteral QI parallels triliteral Form II; QII (تَفَعْلَلَ) parallels Form V.

exercises.prompt: True or False: The verb اِطْمَأَنَّ ('to feel tranquil') derives from the four-consonant root ط-م-أ-ن.
exercises.explanation: True. اِطْمَأَنَّ is a derived quadriliteral (pattern اِفْعَلَلَّ) from root ط-م-أ-ن.

feedback.rule: Pattern اِفْعَلَلَّ is derived quadriliteral Form IV.
